title: Default lichen-node build retains dead raw link-metric parser
description: Strict Rust gate reports handle_frame_rpl_with_link_internal in lichen-node/src/node.rs is dead in the default build. It is only called by the raw-rpl-test-api public wrapper, so the internal function must share that feature gate (or gain a production callsite); otherwise -D warnings fails dependent gateway clippy.
